title: X Player Bridge
name: x_player_bridge
short_description: Ecosystem bridge integrating x_player_api's dual-format character models with 3d_armor, skinsdb, shields, and wieldview.
long_description:
An ecosystem integration bridge that seamlessly connects `x_player_api`'s next-generation dual-model visual architecture (`.glb` multi-track and `.b3d` single-timeline fallbacks) with popular player equipment, skin, and weapon mods in Luanti.

## Features

- **3D Armor Integration (`3d_armor`)**: Bundles `3d_armor_character.glb` and `3d_armor_character.b3d` with full armor UV layout support. Automatically synchronizes composited armor texture layers and helmet/chest/leggings/boots visuals across dual visual proxy entities while preserving multi-track glTF animations.
- **Locked-Foot Bow Animation**: `3d_armor_character.glb` features an athletic courtly bow animation where the upper torso bends respectfully while the feet stay firmly planted on the ground without sliding.
- **Shields Integration (`shields`)**: Bridges shield equip events and active blocking guard postures (`block`) into `x_player_api`'s action layer when defending against incoming attacks.
- **Wieldview Optimization (`wieldview`)**: Dynamically toggles 2D hand texture compositing to prevent duplicate items or z-fighting when `x_player_api`'s native 3D wield items are enabled.
- **SkinsDB Redirection (`skinsdb`)**: Provides transparent model redirection from `skinsdb_3d_armor_character_5.b3d` to the dual-format character models without monkey-patching core functions.
- **Modular & Granular Toggles**: Each integration module can be individually enabled or disabled via `settingtypes.txt` or `luanti.conf`.

## Quick Setup

Simply install and enable `x_player_bridge` alongside `x_player_api` and any supported mod (`3d_armor`, `skinsdb`, `shields`, `wieldview`). The bridge automatically detects active mods at startup and activates the corresponding handlers.
